pandas.DataFrame.quantile

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Estimate the value at a specified fraction of the sorted distribution.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

DataFrame.quantile(q=0.5, axis=0, numeric_only=False, interpolation='linear', method='single')
